verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents Iceberg managed tables that keep data in customer-owned storage buckets in the open Iceberg format, readable by open-source and third-party engines. It also supports open table formats like Iceberg, Delta, and Hudi. Together these give an open-format path for data you can take elsewhere, but only for data stored in those table types; the pack never documents a bulk export of standard BigQuery tables. Missing for 10: documented export/extract of all standard tables to open file formats (e.g., Parquet/Avro/CSV), evidence covering a complete account-wide data exit, independent or hands-on corroboration of migrating off BigQuery.
